name: AniDoki
description: Synchronize anime watch status between Jellyfin and anime tracking sites.

versions.changelog:
## What's Changed
* Name the tracker entry behind each result in toasts, the manual card and Discord by @traejiik in https://github.com/traejiik/jellyfin-anidoki/pull/29


**Full Changelog**: https://github.com/traejiik/jellyfin-anidoki/compare/v1.3.1...v1.3.2

## What's Changed
* Follow sequels when a tracker splits a season, and describe manual card results by @traejiik in https://github.com/traejiik/jellyfin-anidoki/pull/28

## What's Changed
* Record current sync decisions before the provider split by @traejiik in https://github.com/traejiik/jellyfin-anidoki/pull/23
* Keep tracker credentials out of the plugin configuration by @traejiik in https://github.com/traejiik/jellyfin-anidoki/pull/24
* Stop blocking threads while paging tracker lists by @traejiik in https://github.com/traejiik/jellyfin-anidoki/pull/25
* Run manual syncs in the background and fix the Jellyfin → Trackers hang by @traejiik in https://github.com/traejiik/jellyfin-anidoki/pull/26
